en.t: The sun set in the west.

units.source_text: 但是他对阅读书脊上的字还兴致勃勃。

en.t: But he was still eager to read the words on the book spines.

units.source_text: 书架上陈列的，不仅仅是书籍，更是世纪本身。

en.t: What was displayed on the shelves was not merely books, but the century itself.

units.source_text: 尼采、魏尔伦、龚古尔兄弟、陀思妥耶夫斯基、霍普特曼、福楼拜……

en.t: Nietzsche, Verlaine, the Goncourt brothers, Dostoevsky, Hauptmann, Flaubert...
